name: Fireworks AI
short: Serverless and dedicated inference for open models, billed per token or per GPU-second with optional managed fine-tuning.

plans.name: Serverless Inference
plans.notes: No subscription; billed on input, cached and output tokens, with Auto Reload or a monthly spend cap.

plans.name: On-demand deployments
plans.notes: H100/H200 $8.00, B200 $13.00, B300 $15.00 and GB300 $20.00 per hour; billed per GPU-second.

plans.name: Managed fine-tuning
plans.notes: LoRA SFT for models up to 16B; full-parameter DPO for >300B models reaches $40 per 1M training tokens.
